name: Sequoia & Kings Canyon
about: The groves are reachable most of the year, but the high Sierra backcountry is really only open Jun–Sep.
overview: Jointly administered, adjacent parks home to the giant sequoias, including General Sherman, the largest tree by volume on Earth.
costOverview: Prices stay close to typical national-park levels — the one real outlier is the flat non-US-resident surcharge added on top of the standard entrance pass.

scenic.label: Giant sequoia groves stay striking year-round

specialSeasons.text: The sequoia groves themselves stay open and are genuinely striking dusted in snow, even though the high country above is closed for the season.
